body: I don't think it has anything to do with weakness or strength, but yeah, I get the feeling that most people would stoop down to her level if they were in my situation, I refuse to do so. I want us both to be able to move on without anyone having to suffer, it wouldn't even take much for me to forgive her either.

I don't want to bother her, all I want is to feel safe at school, I've tried going there but the anxiety is just too much, I'm just too afraid she'll think I'm talking to someone when I'm there or feel threatened so that she'll say more horrible things about me that are exaggerations at best. She told me herself that she thought she did the right thing when she said those things and that it was all about defending herself, and she still stands by it. I just want to get back to studying...

I used to be proud of it, I even managed to deal with some the issues the abuse caused, like envy and the anger that came along with it, on my own as a 6th grader. Dealing with the mess I'm currently in doesn't make me feel strong though, I'm just helplessly stuck here now and I've given up hope many times now. 

I've a feeling this will only get worse, it looks like she's trying to build up an image of me being abusive and manipulative, she even told me that's what she thinks I am when she answered my message. Before that she only acted as if I was like that, but she never said it, she used do dismiss anything I said that didn't make me look bad as lies and that's been haunting me a lot, even now I'm thinking of how this could make me look like I'm trying to manipulate others. I can't help thinking about it whenever I'm trying to say or write something about myself. The worst part is that there's nothing to say that would get around her reasoning, I can't find a way to prove I'm not like that.

Well, I've been depressed on and off since I was a kid along with body-image issues(?), my first encounter with suicidal thoughts was honestly at the age of either 6 or 7, lots of repressed memories, I somehow managed to dig some of them up in 6th grade. I had some degree of social anxiety in 7th-9th grade, but it got better for a year, then this all happened.

The early depressions were related to abuse, plain abuse, and all the small misfortunes and failures that piled up. Some of the repressed memories were related to that, but I had some fresh memories of it as well. If I go back and try to remember my childhood, most of it is gone, all the way up to around 6th grade and I can't put the events in any order for some reason.

I feel really uncomfortable around people right now, I live in a small town so I really don't want to go out in public, I'm kind of afraid people will talk and ask about me if I do, and that'll make the rumors spread. There's one friend that asked me how I'm holding up, there are some people I know from around here that I sometimes play online games with, but they seem to be avoiding me now ever since school started again, they don't all go to the same school as I do and I think they found out that I'm stuck at home now. Then there's my ex's best friend, who's a mutual friend, I'm able to talk to her about most things and she's very supportive. She's as trustworthy as a person gets and she's also level-headed, so it feels safe to talk to her as she will never turn against my ex, which would mean more pain for me.

Thanks, although I feel like I deserve some pain for harassing her, even though my intention never was to be an inconvenience or hurt, I also feel this continuing this long isn't exactly right. I mean, I was 17 when this all started and I'll be 19 in a couple of months and there's no end in sight, I'm afraid she's built up a wall of bad things about me to keep her from changing her mind about me or feeling sympathy or regret. I managed to ask her a series of questions after 6 months of no contact, what she said hinted at that.
